requirementDiff.title: Event group multicast distribution
requirementDiff.before: Notification events shall be distributed to subscribed clients over the configured multicast endpoint 239.0.0.1:5555.
requirementDiff.after: Notification events shall be distributed to subscribed clients over the configured multicast endpoint 239.0.0.1:5555.

requirementDiff.title: RPC transport endpoint
requirementDiff.before: Platform RPC traffic shall use the TCP endpoint declared in the execution manifest (127.0.0.1:8080).
requirementDiff.after: Platform RPC traffic shall use the TCP endpoint declared in the execution manifest (127.0.0.1:8080).

requirementDiff.title: End-to-end protection of safety-relevant events
requirementDiff.after: NEW: Safety-relevant notification events shall be protected with E2E Profile 11, including CRC, counter and data ID checks on the receiver side.

requirementDiff.title: UDS request routing
requirementDiff.before: The diagnostic manager shall route an incoming UDS request to the handler registered for its SID and shall answer 0x7F/0x11 when no handler exists.
requirementDiff.after: The diagnostic manager shall route an incoming UDS request to the handler registered for its SID and shall answer 0x7F/0x11 when no handler exists.

requirementDiff.title: Read vehicle data by identifier
requirementDiff.before: ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22) shall serve the DIDs for average speed (0xF50D), fuel amount (0xF52F) and external temperature (0xF546) from the connected-vehicle resource cache.
requirementDiff.after: CHANGED: ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22) shall additionally serve average fuel consumption (0xF55E), engine coolant temperature (0xF505) and odometer value (0xF5A6) with a cache lifetime of at most 5 s.

requirementDiff.title: Security access before privileged services
requirementDiff.after: NEW: SecurityAccess (0x27) seed/key exchange shall gate every privileged diagnostic service, with an attempt-delay timer after three failed key attempts.

requirementDiff.title: ECU reset request
requirementDiff.before: ECUReset (0x11) shall be accepted only in a non-safety-critical machine state and shall confirm the reset before execution.
requirementDiff.after: ECUReset (0x11) shall be accepted only in a non-safety-critical machine state and shall confirm the reset before execution.

requirementDiff.title: Software download and upload over UDS
requirementDiff.before: RequestDownload (0x34), TransferData (0x36) and RequestTransferExit (0x37) shall implement a block-sequence-counter protected download.
requirementDiff.after: CHANGED: RequestDownload (0x34), RequestUpload (0x35), TransferData (0x36) and RequestTransferExit (0x37) shall implement a block-sequence-counter protected transfer in both directions.

requirementDiff.title: Vehicle announcement
requirementDiff.before: The DoIP entity shall emit the configured number of vehicle announcement messages after link-up, carrying the configured EID/GID and logical address.
requirementDiff.after: The DoIP entity shall emit the configured number of vehicle announcement messages after link-up, carrying the configured EID/GID and logical address.

requirementDiff.title: OBD request tunnelling over DoIP
requirementDiff.after: NEW: Legacy OBD-II mode 0x01 requests shall be converted to UDS 0x22 DID requests and tunnelled over the DoIP diagnostic message channel.

requirementDiff.title: Telematics communication loss DTC
requirementDiff.before: Loss of communication with the telematic control module shall set DTC U0198 after the configured debounce time.
requirementDiff.after: Loss of communication with the telematic control module shall set DTC U0198 after the configured debounce time.

requirementDiff.title: Function group state transitions
requirementDiff.before: Execution Management shall support the MachineFG function group with the states Off and StartUp, and shall reject transitions to undeclared states.
requirementDiff.after: Execution Management shall support the MachineFG function group with the states Off and StartUp, and shall reject transitions to undeclared states.

requirementDiff.title: Deterministic client cycle activation
requirementDiff.before: A deterministic application shall be able to wait for the next activation cycle and obtain a reproducible random seed per cycle.

requirementDiff.title: Alive supervision of platform processes
requirementDiff.before: Platform Health Management shall report a supervision failure when fewer than the expected alive indications are reported within the configured reference cycle.
requirementDiff.after: Platform Health Management shall report a supervision failure when fewer than the expected alive indications are reported within the configured reference cycle.

requirementDiff.title: Deadline supervision between checkpoints
requirementDiff.after: NEW: The transition from DeadlineSupervisionSource to DeadlineSupervisionTarget shall be reported as failed when it completes outside the configured [5 ms, 15 ms] window.

requirementDiff.title: Service discovery offer timing
requirementDiff.before: The platform shall announce every provided SOME/IP service instance using an initial offer delay drawn from the configured [100 ms, 200 ms] window, and shall enter the repetition phase afterwards.
requirementDiff.after: The platform shall announce every provided SOME/IP service instance using an initial offer delay drawn from the configured [100 ms, 200 ms] window, shall enter the repetition phase afterwards, and shall stop offering within one cycle of the service going down.

requirementDiff.title: Client find behaviour for required services
requirementDiff.before: A required service instance shall issue FindService entries until the service is seen, honouring the configured initial find delay.
requirementDiff.after: A required service instance shall issue FindService entries until the service is seen, honouring the configured initial find delay.

requirementDiff.title: Machine power mode notification
requirementDiff.before: State Management shall expose the current power mode to subscribed applications through the notifier interface.
requirementDiff.after: State Management shall expose the current power mode to subscribed applications through the notifier interface.
